notes.title: The Balance 100 will Release on July 17th!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The main body is finally finally going to be up, the previous prologue and demo had a mediocre response, but the positive reviews should be enough.
The prologue, Balance 97.261/100, has a current review count of 53 as of July 16th, with 20 in brief and 94% special praise.

The Prologue/Demo "Balance 97.261/100" is now finally going to be patched up to become "Balance 100"!
A brief one-sentence description of the game: control your hands to precisely place items!

The game's operation is rather experimental and requires both hands to operate precisely.
We recommend that interested parties experience the prologue first to see if the game is your cup of tea before purchasing the official version at your discretion.
So the Prologue and Demo will remain in existence even after the official version is launched, and will not be taken offline.

What exactly is the difference between the official version and the prologue?
[olist]
[*] Story Mode patch 100%.
[*] Cat sticker patch 100%.
[*] Cat climbing tower mode patch 100%.
[*] New music unlocked 100%.
[/olist]


Liujiajun
